scripts.deploy: npm run build && cd dist && touch .nojekyll && (git rev-parse --git-dir > /dev/null 2>&1 || (git init -b gh-pages && git remote add origin https://github.com/speakingtrumpetskier-prog/spook-and-spot.git)) && git add -A && git -c user.email=deploy@local -c user.name=deploy commit --allow-empty -m "deploy" && git push -f origin HEAD:gh-pages
